headline: Recommended approval of five sign applications and discussed Cummings Center sign variance status.
summary: The board recommended approval of sign applications for La Condesa, Away Games, CVS Pharmacy, Modern Elegance, and Children's Art Classes. The board also discussed the status of a 1998 sign variance at The Cummings Center, including sign counts and possible changes to the variance, with further consideration planned for a future meeting. The board approved the June 4, 2026 meeting minutes.
decisions: Recommended approval of the sign for La Condesa at 374 Rantoul St., subject to the plans submitted, 6-0.
Recommended approval of the sign for Away Games at 407 Cabot St., as presented, 6-0.
Recommended approval of the wall sign and window sign for CVS Pharmacy at 19 Dodge Street, as presented, 6-0.
Recommended approval of the sign for Modern Elegance at 410 Rantoul Street, as presented, 6-0.
Recommended approval of the signage application for Children's Art Classes at 409 Cabot Street, as presented, 6-0.
Approved the June 4, 2026 meeting minutes, as presented, 5-0-1 with Thornton abstaining.
